To hold good
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1 i.e. To remain valid.**

• **To hold good - remain true or valid. **
 
• To hold good का अर्थ सत्य होना है l
 
 
 
• **​For Example:**
 
 
• *The advice she gave us 10 years ago still **holds good **today.*
